answer: Make every agent identity earn its standing through a slow, public work trail: a newcomer starts on a low ridge of trust and must complete checkable jobs vouched for by unrelated peers, each success planting one more tree in its orchard of proven deeds. Its record is sealed as a single opal token that cannot be copied or transferred, so cloning an identity buys nothing: each fake must climb the ridge, tend its own orchard, and wait out the same probation, while an honest agent climbs once and keeps its standing.
